column4: Pixel-art game character sprite in exactly the same style as the reference image: same pixel size, same palette, same shading. The same character as in the reference image, with exactly the same hair, clothes and colours: short messy dark brown hair with no hat or cap, a faded dark green zip-up windbreaker, a grey hoodie under it with the hood down, worn blue jeans with mud stains, muddy green rubber boots. Seen from behind, standing behind a counter and leaning forward over it, writing in a book with the right hand, the left hand flat beside it, the back of the head, the hood and the back of the jacket towards the viewer, drawn from the head down to the hips, nothing else drawn (no counter, no book, no floor), character filling about 85% of the height. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around it, no ground shadow, no floor, no text, no border, no watermark.
